name: cognisphere
description: Agent harness plus a per-project vault: guards (master, secrets, memory drift) copied into each repo, versioned, so they run for the whole team without the plugin; and the vault's own hooks, from the plugin: a SessionStart hook that loads the vault's reading order, a PreToolUse hook that keeps working state out of Claude Code's scratchpad and auto-memory, PostToolUse hooks that remind the agent of its Scratch plan and copy plan-mode plans into Scratch, a Stop hook that asks for the session log and the Scratch working notes, .agents scaffold, /cognisphere:harness and /cognisphere:vault for either half alone, /cognisphere:read for vault notes copied in Obsidian, memory and rules mapping, explorer, planner, implementer, test-runner and reviewer agents, an Obsidian-ready Agent/ workspace outside the repo, and --project on every setup command for monorepo sub-projects with a harness of their own.
